name: TOYA S.A.
summary: TOYA S.A. produces and sells hand and power tools, professional gastronomy equipment, and home equipment in Poland and internationally. The company provides battery, electric, combustion, pneumatic, and manual tools, as well as health and safety products; refrigeration equipment, worktables, transport thermoses, fryers, grills, meat mincers and others; tool kits, accessories, and equipment for working in the garage and home workshop; and manual and pneumatic tools for electricians, locksmiths, service technicians, welders, and plumbers, as well as hobbyists.
